import re
import unicodedata


def normalize(value):
    # Casefold and NFKD-normalize (handles e.g. ß → ss)
    value = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", value).casefold()
    # Replace each run of whitespace or hyphens with a single underscore

    # Trim outer underscores
